SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

3. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

7. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

8. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   D. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.

12. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

16. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Regional co- operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
